name: wide-group-right-border
source:
architecture-beta
  group wide(cloud)[Wider source group]
  group receiving(cloud)[Receiving group]
  service a(server)[First] in wide
  service b(server)[Second] in wide
  service c(server)[Third] in wide
  service d(server)[Fourth] in wide
  service e(server)[Fifth] in wide
  service destination(server)[Destination] in receiving
  align row a b c d e destination
  a:R -- L:b
  b:R -- L:c
  c:R -- L:d
  d:R -- L:e
  a{group}:R -- L:destination{group}
